title: Co2NiO4/NF as a bidirectional catalyst for quinoxaline hydrogenation/tetrahydroquinoxaline dehydrogenation in flow batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00166A, Paper
Fangcheng Qiu, Nan Wang, Bowen Chen, Xin Zheng, Hanyu Li, Xue Han, Shaowen Tan, Siyi Chen, Shengping Wang
The Co2NiO4/NF bifunctional catalyst achieves ∼100% reversible hydrogenation/dehydrogenation conversion of quinoxaline/tetrahydroquinoxaline under mild conditions, providing support for the research on practical quinoxaline-based flow batteries.
